content_sections.heading: About ICDS Bilaspur Urban
content_sections.text: The Integrated Child Development Project Bilaspur Urban is the project office for Anganwadi Centre No. 37 Indira Nagar Tikrapara, the centre where this post is vacant. The recruitment notice was issued from Bilaspur on 21 October 2026 and published by Chhattisgarh Jansampark, the Directorate of Public Relations of the Government of Chhattisgarh, on its website.
